items.caption: A modern redraw of 口 in a late Shang bronze-script style, associated with the vessel 四祀⿰弋卩其卣.
items.alt: Black, rounded open outline with a broad horizontal bar, forming a mouth-like shape.
items.selection_reason: The visible form offers a clear early example of the mouth pictograph described in the character entry; the vessel association identifies its context, though the redraw is not the inscription itself.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw associated with a named vessel, not a photograph of the inscription; the underlying inscription image was not independently examined, so fine details of the original graph cannot be confirmed from this example.
The selected Shang bronze example does not establish a detailed sequence of graphic changes or the first attestation of 口.
